title: Compact TUI information hierarchy

trigger.user_feedback: The current TUI gives the user too much routine information.
trigger.current_behavior: The default operator monitor prints tool start and successful completion as separate lines and includes argument-key lists and trace identifiers; startup information is also spread across several lines.
trigger.preserved_requirement: Users must still be able to see which tool is being used and must receive clear failures, generated OAuth operator keys and public Quick Tunnel URLs.

implementation_plan: Introduce a typed compact-versus-verbose operator presentation mode in mtm-runtime without changing observer authority.
Make compact event formatting optional-output so routine successful completion events can be intentionally silent.
Keep the existing detailed lifecycle representation behind an explicit TUI verbose flag, still redacted to argument keys rather than values.
Compress CLI startup lines into a short identity/status line plus MCP endpoint and only the credentials/tunnel information the user actually needs.
Add regression tests for compact tool visibility, duplicate-success suppression, failure visibility, verbose compatibility and redaction.
Run a real local OAuth/MCP TUI smoke that invokes tools and inspects the actual captured TUI output.

acceptance.A0: Full format, Clippy, workspace tests, governance and unified local gate pass.
acceptance.A1: Compact and verbose output have deterministic tested text contracts; compact mode removes routine diagnostic metadata but preserves required operating information.
acceptance.A3: No argument value, capability, OAuth secret, bearer token or other sensitive field is introduced into TUI output; operator remains presentation-only.
acceptance.A4: A real local OAuth/MCP TUI process shows tool identity in compact mode, omits successful done/trace/arg-key noise, shows failures, and supports verbose fallback.

rollback: Revert MTM-012 presentation changes and restore the preview.2 selector. No database, run state, capability, project revision or proof artifact changes are required.
manual_pending: Implement and test the compact/verbose event formatter.
Run the real TUI OAuth/MCP acceptance smoke.
Package and install a new preview only after all MTM-012 gates pass.
